s038000.name: Football data tables
summary: $038000: unused values $13-$19 (not referenced).
$038007: X speed change indexed by the ground slope, $03800E: Y speed of the next bounce chosen at random.

Football.name: Football sprite main routine
summary: Bouncing football: reverses X speed on walls, zeroes Y speed on ceilings and, each time it lands, flips horizontally,
picks a random bounce height and adds a slope-dependent push to its X speed (clamped to +/-$20).
Does nothing while sprites are locked; [$1540] > 1 freezes it, [$1540] = 1 spawns a smoke puff (probably spin-jump kill).

BigBooBoss.name: Big Boo boss main routine
summary: Draws the boss, updates its fade palette and dispatches on state [$C2] through BooBossPtrs.
When the sprite slot is freed (status 0) the level ends: sets cutscene flag [$13C6], end timer [$1493] = $FF and level end music.

BooBossPtrs.name: Pointer table: Big Boo boss states
summary: States: 0 hidden wait, 1 fade in, 2 normal movement, 3 hit, 4 fade out, 5 hidden movement, 6 defeated.
Also holds the code for state 0 (CODE_0380BE, waits $50 frames with graphics frame 3) and state 1 (CODE_0380D5,
steps the palette index [$190B] up every 8 frames until 7, then state 2).

s0380FA.name: Data: Big Boo boss movement tables
summary: X/Y acceleration and max speed pairs (reversed when the max is reached) and the turn animation frames.

s038106.name: Big Boo boss: remaining states and helpers
summary: State 5 (hidden and moving, then back to state 0), state 2 (visible: sprite hit check, turn toward Mario, drift every 8th frame),
state 3 (hit: flash, 3rd hit = defeated and KillMostSprites), state 4 (fade out), state 6 (killed, flung upward).
$0381E4: checks sprite slots 0-$0B for a carryable or kicked sprite touching the boss; it is destroyed and shatters like a block.
$038239 (JSL, also called from bank $02): queues a CGRAM upload of 8 colors for fade step [$190B] and sets [$40] for transparency.

BigBooDispX.name: Table: Big Boo X tile offsets
summary: 80 entries: 4 graphics frames x 20 tiles (16x16), X offset of each tile.

BigBooDispY.name: Table: Big Boo Y tile offsets
summary: 40 entries: 2 sets x 20 tiles. Set 0 for frames 0-2, set 1 for frame 3 (hiding).

BigBooTiles.name: Table: Big Boo tile numbers
summary: 80 entries: 4 graphics frames x 20 tiles.

BigBooGfxProp.name: Big Boo graphics routine, flip table
summary: Properties table (X/Y flip bits), then the drawing code at $038398 (wrapper, also called from bank $01 for the Boo block).
Sprite $37 only picks a frame (0, 6, or flashing 2/3) and uses the generic routine; others draw 20 16x16 tiles,
mirroring the X offsets within a $28 wide area when direction is 0.
Parameters: X: sprite index.

GreyFallingPlat.name: Grey falling platform main routine
summary: Platform that falls when Mario stands on it: starts at Y speed 3, waits [$1540] = $18 frames, then accelerates by 2 up to $40.

FallingPlatDispX.name: Table: falling platform tile X offsets

FallingPlatTiles.name: Falling platform tiles and graphics routine
summary: Tile table, then CODE_038492 which draws four 16x16 tiles in a row (palette 9, GFX page 2).

Blurp.name: Blurp main routine
summary: Swimming fish. Alternates between tiles $A2 and $EC every 8 frames; dead Blurps are drawn flipped.
Every 4th frame Y accelerates up and down within +/-4 (state bit 0 selects the direction); constant X speed +/-8 by facing.

PorcuPuffer.name: Porcu-Puffer main routine
summary: Faces Mario and accelerates toward him (+/-1 every 4th frame, max $10). X speed is temporarily boosted by [$17BD] * 8 for movement.
Y speed is 4 (sinks) out of water and $FC (rises) in water.

PocruPufferGfxProp.name: Porcu-Puffer graphics routine
summary: Property table, then CODE_0385A3: draws four 16x16 tiles in a 2x2 layout; tile set swaps every 4 frames, layout mirrored by direction.

FlyingTurnBlocks.name: Flying grey turnblocks main routine
summary: Platform that starts moving right at X speed 8 (flag [$1B9A] = 8) once Mario stands on it, bobbing up and down;
[$1602] is used as the direction switch timer (not a graphics frame). Also starts the first other $C1 sprite found in slots 0-9.

ForestPlatDispX.name: Table: flying turnblocks tile X offsets
summary: 2 frames x 5 tiles (3 blocks + 2 wings).

ForestPlatDispY.name: Table: flying turnblocks tile Y offsets
